BiblicalUsage: Silence, or a lament, the word the sailors lift over Tyre, saying what city is like Tyre, like the destroyed in the midst of the sea.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the lament over Tyre is the end of every pride that trusted in ships and silver, because the sea keeps what it takes.
